labels: enhancement

---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of the configuration or experiment limitation you're running into. Ex. I can't compare retrieval strategies against a custom rubric because [...]

## Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen — e.g., a new extension point usage, a new built-in dataset loader, support for another retrieval/calibration strategy, a new `metrics.custom` metric, or a new `criteria_aggregation` formula.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative approaches (e.g., an existing extension in `extensions/`, a manual `--set` override, a different rubric/config) you've considered.

## Use Case / Motivation
Why does this matter for agent-based essay scoring or evaluation? Which RQ (RQ1 retrieval, RQ2 architecture, RQ3 reasoning, RQ4 adjudication), dataset(s), or metric comparison would benefit?

## Additional Context
Any other context, sample configs/rubrics, or metric/comparison output that might be helpful.

## Checklist
- [ ] I've searched existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's scope (agent-based automated essay scoring experiments)
- [ ] I can provide details on the config/dataset/use case
